prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop website first viewport, landscape 1536 by 1024.
Primary request: Create the Dream Clean housekeeping homepage as “The Welcome Book”: a refined guesthouse welcome-book inspired website for a local cleaning company in Macon, Georgia. This is a flat front-on website screenshot, not a photo of a physical book or device. The wide main hero reads as an open stationery book spread with a subtle center fold, warm cream paper and fine forest-green ink; blue accents from the supplied brand. The left page is a personal local introduction with beautifully typeset editorial serif headline, restrained small sans-serif labels, generous readable whitespace, a clear blue Request a quote button and phone action. The right page contains a large naturally lit photograph of a beautifully clean, welcoming Southern living room and glimpse of kitchen, with pale oak, linen, clean surfaces and gentle greenery. Photograph is contained on the page with an elegant caption. Keep the cleaning purpose unmistakable and the atmosphere quiet, local and welcoming.
Input images: supplied logo is reference for existing Dream Clean wordmark and cloud outline identity, use accurately as compact header branding, not as a giant hero.
Composition: modest warm cream site header across the top, logo left, “Housekeeping”, “Move-in / move-out”, “Our area”, phone right; then a broad book-like spread nearly full width at generous margins. Left text occupies 42 percent, right photo 58 percent with offset fine caption. A small continuation strip at bottom names the two client routes, “For your home” and “For your next occupants”. This is a polished real website screenshot with practical links, no floating mockup cards.
Palette: warm stationery #f5efe3, forest ink #2c3931, restrained blue #4d6dad.
Text verbatim: header “Dream Clean” and “HOUSEKEEPING CO.”; eyebrow “MACON & MIDDLE GEORGIA”; headline “A fresh start.\nA calmer home.”; introduction “Housekeeping that brings renewed tranquility to homes across Middle Georgia.”; supporting sentence “For homeowners, apartment communities and Airbnb properties preparing for a move-in or move-out.”; primary button “Request a quote”; phone “(678) 232-8614”; photo caption “A little room to breathe.”; bottom route titles “For your home” and “For your next occupants”; tiny book folio “01 / WELCOME”.
Typography: sophisticated readable book serif headline, quiet sans body with comfortable line length, no overly ornate type. Strong hierarchy, warm restrained editorial design.
Constraints: Do not invent reviews, awards, insurance, guarantees, prices, experience, staff or additional services. No booking promises, property management services or hospitality-service implications. No browser chrome, no device framing, no watermarks. Keep all UI text crisp and correctly spelled. Landscape screenshot.
